description: This is the main entry point for a .NET Web API application, configuring services, middleware, health check endpoints, validation utility endpoint, and documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger) setup.

classes.name: ValidityCheckRequest
classes.description: A request model for the validity check endpoint, containing a single string property 'Value' with validation attributes.

classes.name: ValidityCheckResponse
classes.description: A response model indicating whether a value is valid and providing an optional reason.

methods.name: BuildPublishedServerUrl
methods.description: Constructs the server URL to be published in the OpenAPI document, using request headers and environment variables.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenApiDocument
methods.description: Configures the OpenAPI document, setting the server URL for Swagger UI.
